name: Incline Cable Bench Flye
alternative_names: High Cable Flye on Incline Bench
description: The incline cable bench flye targets the clavicular head of the pectoralis major by combining the stretch-loaded arc of a cable fly with an inclined torso position. The constant tension from cables provides superior stimulus to the upper chest fibers compared to free-weight alternatives.

execution.starting_position: Set an adjustable bench to a 30-45 degree incline and position it between dual low cable pulleys. Lie back on the bench, holding one D-handle in each hand with arms extended above the upper chest.
execution.setup_instructions: Attach D-handles to the lowest pulley setting on both sides of a dual cable machine. Set the bench incline between 30 and 45 degrees and center it in the cable station.
steps: Step 1: Lie on the incline bench and grasp both handles, arms extended up and inward.
Step 2: Open the arms out to the sides in a wide arc, lowering until a stretch is felt across the upper chest.
Step 3: Squeeze the chest and drive both handles together, meeting above the upper pectorals.
Step 4: Pause briefly at the peak contraction before slowly reversing the motion.
Step 5: Maintain a fixed elbow angle and avoid letting the shoulder blades lift off the bench.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale as you bring the cables together. Inhale as you lower the arms out to the sides.
common_mistakes: Setting the cables too high, reducing target stretch on the clavicular head
Straightening the elbows fully under load
Letting the shoulders creep toward the ears
safety_considerations: Retract and depress the shoulder blades before beginning
Start with lighter weight to find comfortable range of motion
Stop if you feel pinching in the anterior shoulder
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Lower arms until the elbows are roughly level with the bench, allowing a full upper chest stretch. Bring hands together above the upper chest for a strong peak contraction.
coaching_cues: Push through the outer arm, not the hands
Upper chest is the target — feel it stretch wide
Squeeze and hold for a beat at the top
